description.en: East Wales is a loosely-defined region of Wales covering its eastern parts, and a former International Territorial Level statistical region of Wales. Various organisations in Wales use various methodologies to sub-divide territory, and most of them use a North–South divide.

description.zh-TW: 東威爾斯是一個指威爾斯東部地區的術語。

description.en: This older Scottish statistical grouping joins Glasgow and the Clyde area with Ayrshire, Lanarkshire and Dumfries and Galloway. It spans the urban west-central belt and the more rural south-west; its historical statistical outline should not be read as a cultural frontier.
description.zh-CN: 这一较早的苏格兰统计分区，将格拉斯哥与克莱德河一带，同艾尔郡、拉纳克郡及邓弗里斯和加洛韦相连。范围横跨西部中央地带的城镇与西南部乡野；图中的旧统计边界不是文化界线。
description.zh-TW: 這一較早的蘇格蘭統計分區，將格拉斯哥與克萊德河一帶，同艾爾郡、拉納克郡及鄧弗里斯和加洛韋相連。範圍橫跨西部中央地帶的城鎮與西南部鄉野；圖中的舊統計邊界不是文化界線。

description.en: Yorkshire and the Humber is one of the nine official regions of England at the first level of ITL for statistical purposes. It is one of the three regions covering Northern England, alongside the North West England and North East England regions, and covers the historic and cultural Yorkshire area.
description.zh-CN: 约克郡-亨伯，英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，涵蓋過去的約克郡以及林肯郡北部。2011年時有人口5,284,000人。
description.zh-TW: 約克郡-亨伯，英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，涵蓋過去的約克郡以及林肯郡北部。2011年時有人口5,284,000人。

description.en: South East England is one of the nine official regions of England that are in the top level category for statistical purposes. It consists of the nine counties of Berkshire, Buckinghamshire, East Sussex, Hampshire, the Isle of Wight, Kent, Oxfordshire, Surrey and West Sussex.
description.zh-CN: 東南英格蘭是英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一。東南區境內包含一座南唐斯國立公園 ，而位於漢普郡和東薩塞克斯郡東岸的七姐妹巖 是在2009年夏天，懸崖風景照片被選為微軟作業系統Windows 7官方桌面壁紙的一部分。

description.en: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, commonly known as the United Kingdom or Britain, is a country in Northwestern Europe, off the coast of the continental mainland. It comprises England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, with a population of over 69 million in 2025.
description.zh-CN: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国，簡稱联合王国或不列颠，通稱英国，是位於西歐的國家，地理範圍包括大不列颠岛、北爱尔兰及一系列小岛屿。英国由大西洋所环抱，东面北海，南與歐洲大陸隔英吉利海峽相望，西南偏南为凱爾特海，大不列顛本土西側與爱尔兰島隔愛爾蘭海。
description.zh-TW: 大不列顛及北愛爾蘭聯合王國，簡稱聯合王國或不列顛，通稱英國，是位於西歐的國家，地理範圍包括大不列顛島、北愛爾蘭及一系列小島嶼。英國由大西洋所環抱，東面北海，南與歐洲大陸隔英吉利海峽相望，西南偏南爲凱爾特海，大不列顛本土西側與愛爾蘭島隔愛爾蘭海。

photo.alt: Cambridge Science Park Napp Pharmaceutical Group building in April 2011.
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: The West Midlands is one of nine official regions of England at the first level of International Territorial Level for statistical purposes. It covers the western half of the area known traditionally as the Midlands.
description.zh-CN: 西密德蘭是英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，位於中部以西一帶。
description.zh-TW: 西密德蘭是英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，位於中部以西一帶。

photo.alt: Coventry's Upper Precinct which was designed by city architect Donald Gibson. The Precinct was aligned on the tower and spire of St Michael's Cathedral which was destroyed by fire in the blitz.
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Northern Ireland is a part of the United Kingdom in the north-east of the island of Ireland. It has been variously described as a country, province or region.
description.zh-CN: 北愛爾蘭是英國的組成部分，位于爱尔兰岛东北部，擁有國家、省、地區這些不同的術語稱呼。北愛爾蘭的西部和南部與愛爾蘭共和國保持著邊境開放。
description.zh-TW: 北愛爾蘭是英國的組成部分，位於愛爾蘭島東北部，擁有國家、省、地區這些不同的術語稱呼。北愛爾蘭的西部和南部與愛爾蘭共和國保持著邊境開放。

photo.alt: Belfast City Hall, Belfast, Northern Ireland, October 2010 (viewed from inside the Linen Hall Library)
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: North East England is one of nine official regions of England. It consists of County Durham, Northumberland, Tyne and Wear and part of North Yorkshire.
description.zh-CN: 東北英格蘭，英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，東面臨海，主要以小型城市為主，包括新特蘭和紐卡素。
description.zh-TW: 東北英格蘭，英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，東面臨海，主要以小型城市為主，包括新特蘭和紐卡素。

photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: The Highlands and Islands is an area of Scotland broadly covering the Scottish Highlands, plus Orkney, Shetland, and the Hebrides . The Highlands and Islands are sometimes defined as the area to which the Crofters Holdings Act 1886 applied.
description.zh-CN: 高地和群岛是苏格兰的一个地理和文化分区，通常指苏格兰高地、奥克尼、设得兰以及外赫布里底群岛。
description.zh-TW: 高地和羣島是蘇格蘭的一個地理和文化分區，通常指蘇格蘭高地、奧克尼、設得蘭以及外赫布里底羣島。

description.en: The East Midlands is one of nine official regions of England. It comprises the eastern half of the area traditionally known as the Midlands.
description.zh-CN: 東密德蘭是英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，位於中部以東一帶。
description.zh-TW: 東密德蘭是英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，位於中部以東一帶。

photo.alt: Built to replace All Hallows Church which was destroyed in the Great Fire of Northampton 1675. Charles II gave 1000 tons of timber to rebuild the town, of which 10 per cent was used to build All Saints. The tower of All Hallows survived and was incorporated into Henry Bell's Christopher Wren-influenced new design, which also includes a dome supported on Ionic columns and a barrel-vaulted nave. The church was consecrated in 1680 and the portico was added in 1701, along with a statue of King Charles. On Oak Apple Day each year the statue is adorned with a wreath of oak leaves.

description.en: West Wales and the Valleys is a former statistical grouping joining western Wales with the South Wales Valleys. It was used to organise regional development funding; its map outline is a statistical geography rather than a distinct cultural border.
description.zh-CN: 西威尔士与山谷地带是一个较早的统计分组，将威尔士西部与南威尔士诸山谷合在一起，曾用于地区发展资金的规划。图中的范围属于统计地理，不应被理解为独立的文化边界。
description.zh-TW: 西威爾士與山谷地帶是一個較早的統計分組，將威爾士西部與南威爾士諸山谷合在一起，曾用於地區發展資金的規劃。圖中的範圍屬於統計地理，不應被理解為獨立的文化邊界。

description.en: North West England is one of nine official regions of England and consists of the ceremonial counties of Cheshire, Cumbria, Greater Manchester, Lancashire and Merseyside. The North West had a population of 7,417,397 in 2021.
description.zh-CN: 西北英格蘭是英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，主要以重工業城市為主，包括曼徹斯特、利物浦等等，瀕臨西面的大西洋。工業革命時代主要以製造業為主，同時是造船基地。
description.zh-TW: 西北英格蘭是英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，主要以重工業城市為主，包括曼徹斯特、利物浦等等，瀕臨西面的大西洋。工業革命時代主要以製造業為主，同時是造船基地。

description.en: The East of England is one of nine official regions of England at the first level of ITL for statistical purposes. It consists of the ceremonial counties of Bedfordshire, Cambridgeshire, Essex, Hertfordshire, Norfolk and Suffolk.

description.zh-TW: 東英格蘭是英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一。

description.en: North Eastern Scotland comprises Aberdeen City and Aberdeenshire in this statistical grouping. The North Sea coast and Aberdeen's urban landscape meet the rural hinterland of Aberdeenshire. This grouping is a geographical guide, not a claim of a sharp cultural border.
description.zh-CN: 本图的苏格兰东北部分区由阿伯丁市和阿伯丁郡组成。北海沿岸、阿伯丁的城市景观与阿伯丁郡的乡野腹地在这里相接。这一统计分组用于地理导览，不表示文化在边界处截然分开。
description.zh-TW: 本圖的蘇格蘭東北部分區由阿伯丁市和阿伯丁郡組成。北海沿岸、阿伯丁的城市景觀與阿伯丁郡的鄉野腹地在這裡相接。這一統計分組用於地理導覽，不表示文化在邊界處截然分開。

description.en: Greater London is an administrative area in England, coterminous with the London region, containing most of the continuous urban area of London. It contains 33 local government districts: the 32 London boroughs, which form a ceremonial county also called Greater London, and the City of London, which is a separate ceremonial county.
description.zh-CN: 大倫敦，位於英國英格蘭東南部，是英格蘭下屬的一級行政區劃之一，範圍大致包含英國首都倫敦首都直轄市與其周圍的衛星城鎮所組成的都會區。行政上，該區域是依據1965年施行的《1963年倫敦政府法令》設置，其下包含倫敦市與32個倫敦自治市，共33個次級行政區。
description.zh-TW: 大倫敦，位於英國英格蘭東南部，是英格蘭下屬的一級行政區劃之一，範圍大致包含英國首都倫敦首都直轄市與其周圍的衛星城鎮所組成的都會區。行政上，該區域是依據1965年施行的《1963年倫敦政府法令》設置，其下包含倫敦市與32個倫敦自治市，共33個次級行政區。

photo.alt: High-rise buildings of the City of London together with part of the Tower of London, seen from the west walkway of Tower Bridge. Buildings visible include 20 Fenchurch Street, Tillis Building, 122 Leadenhall Street, The Scalpel (under construction), 30 St Mary Axe, and 100 Bishopgate (under construction).

description.en: Eastern Scotland links the Firth of Forth and Fife with the Tay basin, Angus and the eastern Lowlands. This atlas retains the older statistical grouping, including Edinburgh, Stirling and the Scottish Borders, rather than presenting it as a single cultural boundary.
description.zh-CN: 苏格兰东部连接福斯湾、法夫、泰河流域与东部低地。这幅图沿用较早的统计分区，范围包括爱丁堡、斯特灵及苏格兰边区；它并不代表一条单一文化边界。海湾、河谷与低地城镇构成了这一带的主要地理线索。
description.zh-TW: 蘇格蘭東部連接福斯灣、法夫、泰河流域與東部低地。這幅圖沿用較早的統計分區，範圍包括愛丁堡、斯特靈及蘇格蘭邊區；它並不代表一條單一文化邊界。海灣、河谷與低地城鎮構成了這一帶的主要地理線索。

description.en: South West England, or the South West of England, is one of the nine official regions of England in the United Kingdom. Additionally, it is one of four regions that altogether make up Southern England.
description.zh-CN: 西南英格蘭是英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，也是英國國內最為風景優美且歷史悠久的地區之一。西南區境內包含達特穆爾國立公園和埃克斯穆爾國立公園兩座國立公園，其佔地共1621平方公里。
